svg.title: The standards behind the street.
svg.desc: DynastyNFT is a permanently soulbound ERC-721 with ERC-5192. StreetDeed is transferable ERC-721 with custom owner transfer locks. Character custody is a restricted per-life escrow rather than a generic identity wallet. The deed stock vault is a constrained ERC-6551 account holding ERC-20s. Extracted supported gear, cars and boats use ERC-1155 variants. OMR uses ERC-20 plus permit. EIP-712 signs typed authorizations, and ordinary inventory is not automatically an NFT. Implementation snapshot 30 OCT 2026. Prelaunch: deployment and activation are not verified by this diagram. Sources: omerta-contracts/src/DynastyNFT.sol:50; omerta-contracts/src/StreetDeed.sol:39; omerta-contracts/src/DeedStockAccount.sol:24; omerta-contracts/src/GearVault.sol:24; omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/OmertaRestrictedOMRV2.sol:23.
svg.text: Separate standards. Separate rights. Constrained custody.

g.text: Not every NFT is soulbound. Not every inventory item is an NFT.

svg.text: Implementation snapshot. Deployment, funding and launch activation are separate checks.
